title: Production Readiness Assessment & Deployment Gate Audit

customVazhipaduFeature.summary: Custom Vazhipadu is fully integrated, verified across 25 domains and 60 automated tests, preserving the 13-item invariant, thermal printing, and zero accounting leakage.

financialIntegrationCorrectness.summary: Authoritative receipts flow intact, zero financial double-counting, Cash/Bank books use activeReceipts(), and atomic linked voiding preserves immutable audit trails.

authenticationAndAuthorization.summary: Unauthenticated access rejected by both client and Firestore rules, user sessions handled safely, secrets separated. Warning: Active rules have broad write/delete permissions; candidate rules quarantine delete but remain unpromoted.

firestoreSecurityRuleCompatibility.summary: Candidate rules are 100% structurally and transactionally compatible with application operations and disaster recovery restore; however, candidate rules have NOT been promoted to production and active rules still permit client-side deletion of operational records.

backupAndRestoreReadiness.summary: Local recovery drill and RFC 8785 canonical verification pass in emulator, but NO fresh, verified production backup under schema v23.2 exists; existing local backup is from 2026-10-01 lacking reservations and checksums; restore is non-atomic across >500 document batches.

deploymentPackageReadiness.summary: Frozen release package deploy_staging_step_33_43/ was frozen at STEP 33.43 (AEB01303...) and does NOT contain the approved Custom Vazhipadu implementation (657A4C1C...). Root workspace cannot be deployed directly as it contains test files, reports, and local development artifacts.

productionCleanupReadiness.summary: All 5 mandatory safety gates are unresolved: no fresh production backup, no live inventory, no live manifest, no trustee sign-off, deletion locked on client.

overallProductionDeploymentReadiness.summary: Deployment is blocked by outdated staging package lacking Custom Vazhipadu, missing fresh verified production backup, unpromoted candidate security rules, and unresolved safety gates.

q1_unauthenticatedAccessRejected.evidence: Both client guards (getCurrentFirebaseUser()) and Firestore security rules (isAuthenticated()) enforce request.auth != null. Unauthenticated calls return HTTP 403.

q2_authInitAndSignoutHandling.evidence: initializeFirebase() validates project ID, connects to Auth, and configures sign-out listeners. handleLogout() calls firebase.auth().signOut() cleanly.

q3_threeIntendedUsersAccess.evidence: Firebase Auth email/password authentication is standard; all 3 provisioned user accounts authenticate equivalently without role branching.

q4_expiredSessionsAndAuthFailures.evidence: Client catches Auth errors, maps them to friendly messages, and fails closed. Expired sessions produce permission-denied at the database boundary.

q5_authorizationEnforcedByRules.evidence: Enforced at Cloud Firestore level. Even if UI is bypassed or manipulated, Cloud Firestore rejects unauthenticated writes with PERMISSION_DENIED.

q6_clientConfigSeparatedFromSecrets.evidence: Temple_Accounts-1.html contains only placeholder YOUR_FIREBASE_API_KEY. scripts/generate-firebase-config.js generates runtime config from environment variables. No private keys or service accounts exist in client code.

q7_unsafeLocalFallbackAllowingUnauthOps.evidence: IndexedDB cache updates are strictly downstream of confirmed Firestore transaction success. If unauthenticated, Firestore transaction fails and aborts before cache write.

q8_permissionModelMatchesActualRules.evidence: Application model assumes shared trusted administration. However, active rules allow any authenticated user to delete operational records; candidate rules lock down deletions.

restoreAtomicityRisk.explanation: Google Cloud Firestore limits transactions to 500 writes. Restore uses _batchSetCollection in batches of <= 450 documents. Multi-batch restore is non-atomic across failure scenarios.
mitigationsPresent: Phase 5 Pre-Restore Safety Snapshot exported before first write
Safe merge preserves unmentioned live documents
Monotonic sequence counter merge prevents number rollback
Live voided status takes precedence over unvoided backup data
